# External Analysis Repositories

Add pinned Git submodules here when evaluation or analysis code is maintained in another repository.
Register each submodule in `research/reproducibility/submodules.tsv` and reference its files directly from `research/reproducibility/pipeline.json`.
Do not duplicate the external code into `research/analysis/scripts/`.
